name: catalog-inside-folder
means: plugin/pluginroot.py lets no catalog outside a folder choose that folder's plugin root (chongdae 2.1.0's rule M1, held by the shared file): it reads a link's or a directory marketplace's own catalog only when the catalog's real path lies inside the folder, takes a child <folder>/<NAME> only for a NAME that is one path component and reads that child's catalog only when the child's real path lies inside the folder's — a child that escapes (a relative or absolute symlink, the folder's parent, a chain of links) is the root as named, its catalog not read — and counts a catalog's source only when it resolves by real path to a directory inside the catalog's own folder; a Claude installPath and a Codex cache copy (under a one-component MARKET and NAME) are taken as the host records them, and no catalog inside them is read.
